name: The Engineering Firm
description: Each engineer at the firm leads a different project in a different discipline. Work out who's building what.
clues: Electrical goes with Copper if and only if Copper goes with Tesla.
Between Steel and Tungsten, one goes with Aerospace and the other with Chemical.
Either Ford goes with Aerospace or Chemical goes with Otis.
Either Tungsten goes with Hertz or Steel goes with Electrical.
Hertz, Otis, and Copper go with Aerospace, Chemical, and Electrical, in some order.

hints.text: Suppose Ford went with Chemical — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Ford goes with Chemical.
Ford goes with Chemical, so it can't also go with Aerospace.
Chemical goes with Ford, so Otis can't go with Chemical.
…but now the clue “Either Ford goes with Aerospace or Chemical goes with Otis” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Ford does not go with Chemical.
